name: Arr Stop Monitoring
description: Automatically unmonitor media in Radarr and Sonarr after you watch it in Jellyfin. Stops quality upgrades for content you've already watched.
overview: Stop Radarr/Sonarr from upgrading quality on watched content

versions.changelog:
Initial release
- Automatic unmonitoring for movies in Radarr
- Automatic unmonitoring for episodes in Sonarr
- Smart season completion detection
- User filtering by username
- Configurable watch threshold
- Dry run mode for testing
